scope: Paid compatibility test 01 only, not approval for production
immutableRules: Fixed stake independent of later distribution snapshot
No core administrator override or upgrade
One staking address per seat without total seat cap
3 percent project tax in IMD in each direction, in addition to platform fees
Original wallet allocation and paid reward quota remain independently authenticated
Principal refunds to original depositor and approved work payments to fixed recipient
Four complete suspension weeks preserve fixed old electorates, earned rights and exit.
One seven-day repair; second failure or expiry returns the work reserve.
Exact operating calls use isolated approved budgets; failed calls do not mark completion.
Electorates assemble within seven days; deadlines do not extend when callers are late.
deploymentRequirements: Verified mainnet receipts and runtime of the fixed constitution and creation-code package before submission
Exact core creation bytes from the package must equal the compiled core, and constitution bytes must equal committed English text
Hook creates Core atomically using actual Token and Hook addresses; no mutable binding, administrator, proxy or delegatecall
Actual factory launch must fit current transaction gas/initcode/runtime limits
Read actual Hook.core() and verify all child bindings and official registry after deployment
Confirm requester fee recipient is Hook or perform payer-authorized future-fee handover before acceptance
limitations: These nineteen cases cover positive behavior and ordinary failure handling only, not a complete security audit.
Additional protocol/system requirements in RULE-MAP.md still need final release verification.
Current fixed stake and account/time/token data are local fixtures.
New adversarial or bypass testing remains outside the current authorization.
